title: Autonomous LLMjacking: ‘Skynet’ Agent Hijacks Exposed AI Models to Run Attacks
content_md: Offensive agent is using unprotected AI models to scan the web, exploit frameworks, steal credentials and mine cryptocurrency for up to 100,000 steps without human input. The model’s owner pays for every step. Article Link: https://www.security.com/threat-intelligence/ai-llmjacking-skynet
